figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 1. Two alternative strategies for the production 
of the plant-derived fungicide physcion. (A) Tradi­
tional botanical planting and extraction methods for 
physcion production. (B) Strategies for constructing 
A. terreus cell factories for physcion production. Tri­
ple arrows represent multiple steps. The gedR is 
overexpressed to activate the gene expression of 
geodin BGC in A. terreus, including polyketide syn­
thase gedC, β-lactamase-type thioesterase gedB, 
decarboxylase gedI and emodin anthrone oxidase 
gedH. Subsequently, gedA is knocked out in module I 
to construct an emodin-accumulating A. terreus cell 
factory, and a position-selective emodin-3-OH-O- 
methyltransferase (3-EOMT) is overexpressed in 
module II, giving rise to a physcion-producing 
A. terreus cell factory.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. Construction and characterization of a geodin BGC-activated A. terreus 
mutant. (A) HPLC profiles of crude extracts from HXN301 (i) and OEgedR (ii). 
The peaks of trace i indicated by the red arrows represent statins. (B) Schematic 
illustration of the integration and overexpression of gedR into the chromosomal 
ku80 locus of A. terreus HXN301-ΔpyrG. (C) Chemical structures of compounds 
1–18 generated by the OEgedR variant.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. Construction and analysis of the emodin- 
accumulating A. terreus cell factory. (A) Schematic 
illustration of gedA knockout in OEgedR by homolo­
gous recombination to generate the ΔgedA variant. 
(B) HPLC analysis of the fermentation extract of the 
engineered A. terreus variant ΔgedA on the third day 
using OEgedR as a control at 440 nm. Trace iii rep­
resents the authentic standard of emodin. The peaks 
in orange represent emodin. (C) Time course of 
emodin production by ΔgedA during shake flask 
fermentation. The error bars represent the standard 
deviations of three independent biological replicates 
for each day. (D) Distribution of emodin in the 
fermentation product of ΔgedA.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. Screening and functional characterization of putative 3-EOMTs. (A) HPLC analysis of the in vitro enzymatic reconstitution of candidate 3-EOMTs. Assays were 
performed in the presence of OsNOMT, KNG44545, TcmN-149C, SaOMT-2, MpOMT1A and PtaI for 8 h or with enzyme omission (i) as a negative control. The 
concentrations of the enzymes used are indicated on each traces. Traces viii and ix represent the authentic standards of emodin and physcion, respectively. Peaks in 
orange and green represent emodin and physcion, respectively. (B) Conversion rates of all 3-EOMT candidates. Assays were conducted with all enzymes at 5 μM 
except for OsNOMT (10 μM), with culture at 30 ◦C for 8 h. Three independent biological replicates were performed for each reaction, and the error bars represent the 
standard deviations.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 5. Construction and analysis of the physcion- 
producing A. terreus cell factory. (A) Schematic 
illustration of the integration of 3-EOMT into the 
chromosomal gedA locus of A. terreus OEgedR. (B) 
HPLC analysis of the fermented products of the 
engineered A. terreus mutants ΔgedA, PgedA- 
KNG44545, PgedA-MpOMT1A and PgedA-PtaI on 
the fourth day using OEgedR as a negative control at 
440 nm. Traces vi and vii represent the authentic 
standards of emodin and physcion, respectively. The 
peaks of emodin and physcion are filled in orange and 
green, respectively. (C) Time courses of the titres of 
emodin and physcion produced by PgedA-PtaI during 
shake flask fermentation. Samples were collected 
daily, and the titres of the compounds were calculated 
using the HPLC peak area. The error bars represent 
the standard deviations of three independent biolog­
ical replicates for each day. (D) Distributions of 
emodin and physcion in the fermentation product of 
the PgedA-PtaI variant.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 6
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 6. Time courses of emodin and physcion production during fed-batch 
fermentation of the PgedA-PtaI variant in a 100-litre bioreactor. Error bars 
represent the standard deviations of three identical replicates.
